GeneDef.label: vanilla body
GeneDef.description: Carriers keep the vanilla body texture, even when a texture mod redraws the bodies of everyone else. The body shape stays the one the body type gives.

GeneDef.label: WDI body
GeneDef.description: Carriers keep the body texture of WDI's Realistic Bodies, even when the default for their race or for everyone is another look. Without that mod, nothing changes.

GeneDef.label: UNAGI face
GeneDef.description: Carriers get the face parts of the UNAGI Facial Animation pack, even when another face pack wins the load order. A part the pack does not cover keeps the default face. [NL] Facial Animation - WIP draws the face.
